consumer: The offline map-dump writer that records each nearby tile's raw terrain id string and stores it as ground truth, asking only 'what is the actual terrain at this tile?'
scope: a map region (the nearby tiles around center within radius), reported as raw authoritative world state, not a seen/remembered display view
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles reads ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() per tile, emitting the raw engine terrain string id (e.g. t_floor) directly into the snapshot
divergence: A tile the player has never seen or remembers stale: a display-observability (D) answer would report unknown/last-remembered terrain, but the raw S authority still reports the true t_* id at that tile
